status: prototype runtime derivative; source unapproved, gameReady false; not approved art; no commercial/model licence clearance asserted
deterministic: Fixed parameters, no timestamps or randomness (hash noise); identical input + tool versions reproduce identical bytes.

source.note: iteration-01 runtime derivative of assault-rifle-03 (see derivatives/props.json outputs[rifle]); read only — rifle.glb and every master are unchanged

diagnosis: rifle.glb's ACOG-style scope is one closed, opaque AI surface: the objective is a textured cup closed ~1 cm inside the bell (z≈-0.04 m) and the eyepiece a closed textured disc (z≈+0.085 m); a ray along the scope axis hits opaque triangles at both ends. The iteration-01..03 ADS (aim [0,-0.283,-0.42]) therefore put the eye ~5 cm ABOVE the scope axis and sighted over the housing with the HUD crosshair.

method.detail: Kasa circle fits of mesh cross-sections (points in a 14-32 mm band around a seed centre, 3 rounds of 2 mm outlier rejection). Axis = mean centre of the eyepiece-half slices, constrained parallel to the bore (model -Z) so the reticle line is the bore line.

aiTubeMisalignment.note: measured slope of the AI housing centres vs z; not applied (the axis stays bore-parallel); the bore cut and tube cover the few-mm offset

method.detail: min/max z of AI vertices within 0.03 m of the axis (scope only)

removed every AI triangle with any of 16 barycentric samples inside r < 0.0202 m of the axis and within z ∈ [objective face - 3 mm, eyepiece face + 3 mm], except outward-facing housing facets centred outside the tube wall (mean vertex normal · radial > 0.35, centroid r ≥ 0.0205 m and no sample deeper than r = 0.0188 m; they keep the outside closed and are back faces behind the tube wall from inside the bore); remaining vertices compacted, attributes copied verbatim
all on the fitted axis, 48 segments; triangle winding checked against normals

outerTubeSkin.why: closes small gaps where the AI housing steps down near the offset side of the bore

method.detail: rifle-optic-metal: 512² procedural JPEG (hash fbm grime, circumferential brushing, edge-wear speckle; interior half matte black with baffle rings) whose palette is sampled from the rifle's own baked optic-housing texels; metallic/roughness factors = medians of the rifle ORM texels on the housing. rifle-optic-glass: glTF BLEND, tinted, no texture (world/pickup view). rifle-baked textures untouched.

runtime: game/src/weapons/optic.ts + viewmodel.ts: in the first-person viewmodel the rear glass becomes a depth-masked lens (the world pass shows through the full eyepiece, i.e. a 1x optic image), a collimated reticle (red dot + duplex) drawn by the lens shader at the aim direction, coating tint/sheen, edge vignette and an eye-box exit pupil (dark lens off-axis / at hip). ADS puts the eye on the axis at the configured eye relief behind OpticRear (weapons.ts rifle.view.optic). World pickups use the plain glTF glass.
limitations: The housing remains the AI reconstruction (inferred/blurred detail, mirrored markings); only the lens caps/interior were replaced.

The AI scope tube is a few millimetres off the bore-parallel axis (see aiTubeMisalignment); the authored rings are centred on the axis, so the housing can look slightly eccentric around the eyecup up close.
Optic is a 1x see-through presentation (no picture-in-picture magnification); the ADS camera FOV change is unchanged.
Authored parts use a procedural texture tuned to the rifle palette, not a bake from the source model.
